Id.description: Unique identifier of the resource block.

EnterpriseId.description: Unique identifier of the `Enterprise` the resource block belongs to.

IsActive.description: Whether the resource block is still active.

StartUtc.description: Start of the resource block in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

EndUtc.description: End of the resource block in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the resource block in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the resource block in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

DeletedUtc.description: Date and time when the resource block was deleted (for inactive ones) in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.
